title: Second Carnatic War (1749-54)
quote: First war fought over Indian politics, not a European war: backing Indian claimants brought territory + revenue

boxes.title: Trigger
items: Release of **Chanda Sahib** (son-in-law of Dost Ali) by the **Marathas**
No European war behind this one

items.what: ==**Ambur**==: Anwaruddin killed; Chanda Sahib Nawab; Muhammad Ali fled to **Trichinopoly**
**Nasir Jang** murdered by **Himmat Khan** (Kurnool), Dupleix's plot; Muzaffar Jang Subahdar
==**Siege of Arcot**==: Clive holds it vs **Raja Sahib** for **53 days**
Trichinopoly relieved; **Law** surrenders; Chanda Sahib executed; **Muhammad Ali** Nawab

cards.title: Morari Rao
lines: Maratha chief; English ally with Mysore, Tanjore

boxes.title: Siege of Arcot
items: Chanda Sahib + French besieging Muhammad Ali at Trichinopoly
**Clive** proposed diversionary attack on **Arcot**, the Carnatic capital
Force: ==**210 men**== (UPSC) ⚠ other notes: **200** English + **300** sepoys

boxes.title: Rewards to Dupleix & recall
items: ==Governor (Nawab) of Mughal territory **south of the Krishna**== (APPSC 2021)

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Dupleix won the **Deccan** but lost the **Carnatic** (Arcot, Trichinopoly)
AP angle: Machilipatnam, Diviseema, **Northern Circars** = main French gain
